description: This file defines the ElasticsearchQueryDisplayDriver class, which manages display and editing of Elasticsearch queries within the OrchardCore CMS framework. It handles rendering query summaries, editing query parameters, and updating query metadata.
external_methods: await context.Updater.TryUpdateModelAsync(viewModel, Prefix, m => m.Query, m => m.Index, m => m.ReturnContentItems)

classes.name: ElasticsearchQueryDisplayDriver
classes.description: A display driver class for rendering and editing Elasticsearch queries within OrchardCore.

methods.name: ElasticsearchQueryDisplayDriver
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for the display driver.

methods.name: Display
methods.description: Renders a summary view of the query if the source matches ElasticsearchQuerySource.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Provides an editor interface for modifying Elasticsearch query parameters.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Processes updates to the query based on user input, validating required fields.
